hook: Travel the world through 14 real works of art, from a giant wave in Japan to a blue hippo from Egypt. Look closer, say what you see and feel, and collect a passport stamp for every visit.
outcome: Describe what they see in artworks from many cultures, share how art makes them feel, and connect each work to the people and place that made it
sources: Artworks: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Open Access (public domain, CC0)
